title: Interpretable Feature Engineering for Nanopore Sequencing Basecalling: Learning Biophysical Patterns in Pore Models

contributions.purpose: 证明可解释特征工程在理想化数据上可媲美/超过神经网络
contributions.mechanism: 在 ONT R9.4 pore model 上构造单核苷酸+成对交互特征(420 个),LASSO(λ=0.01,5 折 CV)选 50 个,线性回归
contributions.domain: 纳米孔测序 basecalling / 可解释 ML
contributions.source_quote: We establish that interpretable feature engineering matches neural networks on idealized synthetic benchmarks, motivating investigation with real data

contributions.purpose: 给出完整技术规格以支持复现
contributions.mechanism: LASSO 坐标下降(λ=0.01 via 5 折 CV)、收敛判据 ‖θ(t+1)−θ(t)‖∞<1e−4、复杂度 O(npk)
contributions.evaluation: Model B 推理 100 FLOPs/预测 vs MLP 18690;20/50/100 特征消融(73%/87%/退化)
contributions.source_quote: We provide complete technical specifications: LASSO with coordinate descent (λ = 0.01 via 5-fold CV), convergence criterion... and computational complexity (O(npk) per iteration)

contributions.purpose: 透明披露关键局限并给出真实数据验证路线
contributions.mechanism: 自曝合成数据、弱基线、统计功效不足;发现 position-2 核苷酸主导信号(S:2:G=-5.28)
contributions.evaluation: 同聚物 n=21 96% 降误差但 CI[0.3,1.1] 宽;100 特征反而退化(MSE 4.06)提示过拟合
contributions.source_quote: We transparently acknowledge critical limitations—synthetic-only evaluation, weak baselines, insufficient statistical power—and outline concrete requirements for real-world validation

self_declared_provenance.quote: Recent work demonstrates that careful feature construction can match deep learning performance while maintaining interpretability [3], yet this insight hasn't been applied to nanopore basecalling—until now. Our work bridges this gap

notes: 论文自声明 3 条贡献(intro 结尾)。核心=大量负结果/trade-off:仅噪声无静态合成数据(无 10-20pA 噪声/漂移/变速),弱基线(2 层 MLP 9345 参数 vs 生产级 Guppy 5M/Bonito 10M,自认低估 100-1000×),同聚物 n=21 统计功效不足(80% 功效仅对 >2.0 MSE 差异),100 特征过拟合退化。作者反复自曝'without real signal validation we cannot claim practical relevance'、'remains a theoretical exercise'。checklist AI 披露:hypothesis/analysis/writing 均[D](GPT-5 Thinking 提想法,Cursor 跑实验,Claude 写作,人仅改标题);AI 自曝'references are frequently fabricated or incorrect'。数据红旗:abstract 措辞矛盾——先称'proof-of-concept'又用'This breakthrough reveals fundamental insights'/'not only solve immediate technical challenges';Figure 1 训练曲线为唯一图但无异常。整体诚实度高但结论价值受限于纯合成数据。
